text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh, we're hanging out here today...?
I was planning on heading back and training, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "During the sea glass hunt last time, none of my efforts were able to help Furioso relax."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next time, without any roundabout tricks,
I'll let them play the game freely and happily.
choice_data_list: It's important to really let loose on your days off.
It's important to really let loose on your days off.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I see...?
Well, if that's the case, then sure.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I hope there is a game
that I can enjoy as well...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Espo-n!
Go grab the item~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the big screen, an avatar that looked
just like the player was displayed.
It seemed to be a monster-hunting game.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Out of the way! Scram, you small fry!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're leaning way too far forward!
Gwaaaah...!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh.
Looks like you caught me looking uncool.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think of it that way.
I was merely looking at what it was like."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, the rule here is you yield once you're caught.
I'll switch with you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, it's not that I wanted to play...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso says so, but for now,
I don't have any particular game in mind that looks fun.
Still, it's worth taking a shot.
choice_data_list: We don't have any other plans, so let's check it out and play.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We might have started, but we have no idea what we're doing. I wonder if we'll actually be able to enjoy it...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What's the standard way to play this, I wonder?
For now, should I try picking up some items?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I see, so this increases my defense.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
And look, I also found this.
Apparently, it raises our allies' attack power.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
How's this? Is this the right feel?
Are we getting hype?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm being serious here!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Is it really that strange...?
Hehe... Honestly.
choice_data_list: (Huh... Did she just smile for a second?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, I can't bear to watch this!
At this rate, you're gonna get destroyed!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Where did this come from all of a sudden?!
We don't need any help—
choice_data_list: Ahaha, things are getting quite lively, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Smiling like that again―
How am I supposed to say no?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped.
Just for now, I will join forces with you folks from the URA.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, leave the small fry to me.
Time for payback from earlier!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the stage background changed.
The boss should be showing up right about nooow.
choice_data_list: Alright, bring it on from anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...You've become a total resident of the game world, haven't you?
It's been a while since I've seen you look like you're having so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, back when I was in Funabashi, I used to enjoy
my days off like this too.
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso smiled over at me again.
Could it be that the key to getting her to relax is—"
choice_data_list: (Does this have something to do with me?)
(Does this have something to do with me?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just stand there daydreaming!
The boss is here!!
choice_data_list: ...All right, let's play to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If that's how you want it, Trainer,
then I'm going to have as much fun as I possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a satisfyingly complete defeat, wasn't it?
Especially the way you lost, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm saying you're both terrible! And after we went through the trouble of rushing over here, too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that fine?
Looks like the two of them had plenty of fun.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed.
Thanks to that, it turned into a relaxing holiday.
choice_data_list: I ended up having fun myself along the way.
I ended up having fun myself along the way.
Did you get tired out from having too much fun?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed.
Thanks to that, it turned into a relaxing holiday.
choice_data_list: I ended up having fun myself along the way.
I ended up having fun myself along the way.
Did you get tired out from having too much fun?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be fine?
Rather... you could say it was fun thanks to that.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Hearing your laughter, Trainer,
somehow... made all the tension just melt away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems letting her hair down together really does have a good influence on Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we go out, I'll try my best
to have even more fun together with Furioso!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, it actually feels quite nice.
All that's missing is some pear juice and it'd be perfect.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
When we'd talk over drinks, Trainer,
the sun would go down in the blink of an eye... Ah, the memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Furioso to truly relax,
she probably needs an experience similar to her days in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we go out, I should relax too
and create an atmosphere where we can rest freely!"
